name: TensoRF with Density-Shift Fix
definition: A TensoRF variant that applies a density-shift correction to the density parameterization to stabilize volumetric reconstruction and thresholding, replacing the default parameterization which causes degenerate attenuation geometry.
summary: TensoRF with Density-Shift Fix is a parameter correction that prevents density collapse by replacing default values with zero shift and unit scale, stabilizing volumetric reconstruction.
